text:
mira: Quick plan check — launching the benchmark + webinar next Thurs. Need X + LinkedIn schedule, assets, and inbound routing ready by Tue EOD. Can we do a two-wave rollout with built-in A/B?

tony: Yes. Wave A morning hook (3-tweet thread), Wave B afternoon deep-dive (4 tweets + chart). LinkedIn longform between waves.

ash: Bench headline options: "~35% lower cost per response" or "sub-40ms p95". We'll run A/B. I need the bench snapshot to approve copy.

mira: Design asks: hero GIF (16:9), 1200x628 thumbnail, and alt text. GIF rough by Mon, finals Tue.

ops-bot: HubSpot form + webhook created: https://hooks.example.com/hubspot/launch-3180. Shortlink: https://go.redwood.ai/launch3180 (tracks utm_source=social). Hidden field campaign_variant added. Test payload: {"email":"test@redwood.com","campaign_variant":"A","source":"social"}

ash: Add hidden field 'traffic_bucket' so we can map paid vs organic.

ops-bot: Added traffic_bucket. Scheduler set to America/Los_Angeles timezone. Posts will be native threads with alt text attached.

ads-team: Paid plan: $900 day-of, split 60% AM hook / 40% PM deep-dive. Targeting: platform engineers + PMs. Conversion = form submit.

sdr-bot: Routing: real-time Slack ping to #sdr-inbound on signup + daily CSV digest to sdr@redwood at 8:30am. Tag leads who clicked the GIF as "high-engage".

mira: Copy drafts (short):
- mira: "Cut inference cost ~35% on common prompts. See the benchmark + join the webinar: https://go.redwood.ai/launch3180"
- mira: "Serve responses faster — sub-40ms p95 in our tests. RSVP: https://go.redwood.ai/launch3180"

ash: I'll QA metrics vs bench and sign off. No posting until I approve.

mira: Great — I'll make a Notion checklist and assign owners. Ping when assets land. :rocket:
